text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's late afternoon, and Air Shakur hasn't
turned
up for training yet. I'm starting to
wonder what
happened, when...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, are you serious? I came to check
just in
case, but I didn't think you'd
actually still be here.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: I'm glad you're all right. I thought something had happened...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Most people would be angry right
about
now.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I just got a bit carried away coding. Next
thing I
knew, it was late.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If I get some time, I'll try embedding a
timer in my
code editor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur appears remorseful in her own
way, so
I decide to overlook today's
incident.
